posts.author: Clown
posts.title: ||VM|| Need A Slogan + More
posts.html:
||VM|| Slogan Ideas

Due to future Merchandise ideas we need your help to come up with an appropriate slogan for the Vent Mob gaming community.

Just imagine:                                     
 
Vent Mob
"Your Slogan Here"

I can imagine It would be tempting to make silly suggestions but if we could try and come up with sensible ideas it would be much appreciated since there is a chance your slogan could be used!

Other News

  • You can now reply to News threads, before people found themselves making copy threads just so they could express their thoughts about the news. So it made sense to make this possible.
  • 2 new post count titles have been added to the forum, at 1,000 posts you obtain the 'Epic Member' title and at 2,500 posts you get 'Wise Guardian of Vent Mob' title

lol, our name comes from back when we played very Basis RP, dark RP and we loved it and used to team up (me, kizai, wyvern, chaz and more). We always controlled most of the servers in our organised crime...so naturally people grew jealous and loved hating us.

One ban request was made by some 11 year old on Stoned Potato's (the name of the clan who's server we first started on) and there he referred to us as the 'Vent Mob' referring to the fact we were so organized by using ventrilo. The name stuck and we formed a clan...one thing led to another and here we are today
